Additionally, large and unpredictable changes in market sentiment—whether driven by panic, euphoria, or specific news catalysts—could also create outcomes far outside the modeled expectations. These risks highlight the importance of considering both the probabilities within the intervals and the possibility of extreme deviations beyond those bounds.
